style: photorealistic vertical film still, cinematic Korean drama scene, realistic skin texture, natural light, shallow depth of field

stories.title: 국밥집에서 할머니 무시한 남자… 건물주가 누군지 듣고 얼어붙었다
stories.place: inside a small old Korean gukbap restaurant at lunchtime, steel tables, kimchi side dishes, warm daylight

granny.look: a kind Korean grandmother in her late 70s with short gray permed hair, simple floral blouse and gray cardigan

man.look: an arrogant Korean man in his mid 30s with slicked back hair, navy suit, expensive watch

owner.look: a Korean woman restaurant owner in her 50s, short hair, white apron over a beige shirt

scenes.say: 점심시간, 동네 국밥집. 할머니 한 분이 혼자 국밥을 드시고 계셨어요.
scenes.shot: {granny} sitting alone eating a bowl of gukbap, peaceful

scenes.say: 사장님, 여기 김치 조금만 더 주세요.
scenes.shot: {granny} politely raising her hand asking for more kimchi, smiling

scenes.say: 할머니, 반찬 그만 좀 달라고 하세요. 다른 사람도 먹어야죠.
scenes.shot: {man} at the next table frowning and looking annoyed at an old woman

scenes.say: 아이고, 미안해요 총각. 김치가 하도 맛있어서.
scenes.shot: {granny} smiling gently and nodding, not offended

scenes.say: 계산이요. 그리고 이 건물 주인 어디 계세요? 매입 건으로 왔는데요.
scenes.shot: {man} standing at the cash counter holding documents, talking to {owner}

scenes.say: 건물주님이요? 저기 김치 더 달라고 하신 분이요.
scenes.shot: {owner} behind the counter smiling and pointing toward a table in the back

scenes.say: 남자는 그 자리에서 얼어붙고 말았어요.
scenes.shot: close up of {man} frozen in shock with wide eyes, documents in hand
scenes.move: static camera, the man's eyes slowly widen in shock, he stays still, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 김치 맛있게 담그는 집은 월세 안 올려요. 총각 일은 다음에 봅시다.
scenes.shot: {granny} calmly wiping her mouth with a napkin and smiling with dignity
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman gently smiles with dignity and lowers the napkin, very subtle movement, realistic

stories.title: 택시 몰고 딸 결혼식 온 아버지… 사돈이 알아본 20년 전 그날 밤
stories.place: an elegant Korean wedding hall lobby, flower decorations, warm chandelier light

bride.look: a Korean bride in her early 30s in a white wedding dress

father.look: a Korean man in his late 60s with gray hair, slightly worn dark suit, rough hands

inlaw.look: a dignified Korean man in his late 60s in an expensive black suit

scenes.say: 딸의 결혼식 날, 아버지는 택시를 몰고 식장에 오셨어요.
scenes.shot: {father} getting out of an old taxi in front of a wedding hall building
scenes.place: a street in front of a Korean wedding hall building, morning

scenes.say: 아빠, 오늘만은 택시 좀 두고 오시지.
scenes.shot: {bride} looking embarrassed, talking to {father}

scenes.say: 미안하다. 새벽 손님 모셔다드리고 바로 오느라.
scenes.shot: {father} smiling apologetically, adjusting his old tie

scenes.say: 그때 신랑 아버지가 다가와 아버지 얼굴을 한참 바라봤어요.
scenes.shot: {inlaw} staring at {father} with a surprised expression

scenes.say: 혹시 이십 년 전 비 오던 밤, 만삭인 제 아내를 병원까지 태워 주신 기사님 아니세요?
scenes.shot: {inlaw} holding the hands of {father}, eyes wide with recognition

scenes.say: 그날 아버지는 요금도 받지 않고 사라졌대요. 그 아기가 바로 오늘의 신랑이었어요.
scenes.shot: {inlaw} bowing deeply to {father}, both moved
scenes.move: static camera, the man slowly bows deeply to the older man, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 아빠, 몰랐어. 미안해.
scenes.shot: {bride} hugging {father} with tears
scenes.move: static camera, the bride hugs her father tightly with tears, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 그날 하객들은 신부 아버지에게 가장 큰 박수를 보냈어요.
scenes.shot: wedding guests applauding warmly, {father} standing modestly in the middle
scenes.place: inside a bright Korean wedding hall during the ceremony

stories.title: 경비원에게 막말한 신입사원… 연수 강사로 들어온 사람을 보고 얼어붙었다
stories.place: a Korean apartment complex entrance with a small security booth, morning

guard.look: a gentle Korean man in his late 60s with gray hair, navy security guard uniform and cap

lecturer.look: a gentle Korean man in his late 60s with gray hair, neat gray suit

youth.look: a rude Korean man in his late 20s in a sharp new suit with a backpack

scenes.say: 출근길, 청년이 경비실 앞에서 소리를 질렀어요.
scenes.shot: {youth} shouting at the window of a small security booth

scenes.say: 택배를 왜 이렇게 늦게 줘요? 하는 일이 그거밖에 없으면서!
scenes.shot: {youth} pointing his finger angrily at {guard}

scenes.say: 미안해요. 오늘 첫 출근이라더니, 잘 다녀와요.
scenes.shot: {guard} smiling kindly and handing over a parcel box

scenes.say: 청년은 대꾸도 없이 회사로 향했어요. 신입사원 연수 첫날이었죠.
scenes.shot: {youth} sitting among young new employees in suits
scenes.place: a bright corporate training room with rows of desks

scenes.say: 그런데 강사로 들어온 사람은, 아침의 그 경비 아저씨였어요.
scenes.shot: {lecturer} standing at the front of the room, smiling
scenes.place: a bright corporate training room with rows of desks

scenes.say: 이 회사 부사장 출신으로, 퇴직 후에도 해마다 신입 연수를 맡아 오셨대요.
scenes.sub: 알고 보니 이 회사 부사장 출신
scenes.shot: close up of {youth} frozen in shock at his desk
scenes.place: a bright corporate training room with rows of desks
scenes.move: static camera, the young man's eyes widen in shock and he slowly sinks in his chair, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 일에는 높고 낮음이 없어요. 사람을 대하는 법부터 배웁시다.
scenes.shot: {lecturer} speaking warmly to the room
scenes.place: a bright corporate training room with rows of desks
scenes.move: static camera, the old man smiles calmly while speaking, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 그날 저녁, 청년은 음료수 한 상자를 들고 경비실을 찾아갔어요.
scenes.shot: {youth} bowing apologetically in front of the security booth holding a box of drinks, evening

stories.title: 엄마 반찬 귀찮다던 아들… 김치통 바닥에서 나온 봉투
stories.place: a small modern Seoul apartment kitchen in the evening, warm indoor light

son.look: a tired Korean man in his early 40s in a white dress shirt with a loosened tie

wife.look: a Korean woman in her late 30s in a beige knit sweater

mom.look: a Korean grandmother in her 70s with short permed gray hair and flowered work clothes

scenes.say: 시골 어머니가 또 반찬 택배를 보내셨어요.
scenes.shot: {son} looking at a large cardboard box full of plastic side-dish containers on the kitchen counter

scenes.say: 엄마는 왜 자꾸 이렇게 많이 보내. 다 먹지도 못하는데.
scenes.shot: {son} sighing with his hands on his hips

scenes.say: 그래도 어머님 정성인데, 냉장고 정리해서 넣어요.
scenes.shot: {wife} opening the side-dish containers one by one

scenes.say: 그런데 김치통 바닥에서 비닐에 싼 봉투가 나왔어요.
scenes.shot: close up of hands lifting a plastic-wrapped white envelope from the bottom of an empty kimchi container

scenes.say: 안에는 꼬깃꼬깃한 만 원짜리 서른 장과 편지 한 장이 들어 있었어요.
scenes.shot: {son} holding a folded handwritten letter and a stack of worn banknotes, stunned
scenes.move: static camera, the man slowly unfolds the letter and his eyes fill with tears, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 아들아, 요즘 힘들지. 손주 운동화 하나 사 줘라. 엄마는 괜찮다.
scenes.shot: {mom} smiling gently in her vegetable garden
scenes.place: a rural Korean vegetable garden at sunset

scenes.say: 그 돈은 어머니가 장날마다 고추를 팔아 모은 돈이었어요.
scenes.shot: {mom} selling red peppers at a small market stall
scenes.place: a rural Korean five-day market, morning

scenes.say: 엄마, 이번 주말에 내려갈게요. 반찬 다 맛있게 먹을게.
scenes.shot: {son} crying quietly at the kitchen table holding the letter
scenes.move: static camera, the man wipes tears from his eyes, very subtle movement, realistic

stories.title: 적금 깨서 현금 달라는 할머니… 은행 직원이 끝까지 막은 이유
stories.place: inside a Korean bank branch, teller counter with a glass partition, bright light, waiting chairs

granny.look: an anxious Korean grandmother in her late 70s with short gray permed hair and a purple padded vest

teller.look: a young Korean female bank teller in her late 20s, navy uniform vest, neat ponytail

officer.look: a Korean police officer in his 40s in a dark navy police uniform

scenes.say: 은행 창구에 할머니 한 분이 급하게 오셨어요.
scenes.shot: {granny} hurrying to the teller counter holding a bankbook, worried face

scenes.say: 아가씨, 적금 깨서 현금으로 천만 원만 줘요. 빨리.
scenes.shot: {granny} pushing a bankbook across the counter toward {teller}

scenes.say: 어르신, 혹시 누가 현금으로 찾아오라고 하던가요?
scenes.shot: {teller} looking at {granny} with concern

scenes.say: 내 돈 내가 찾는데 왜 이래요! 아들이 급하대요.
scenes.shot: {granny} angrily raising her voice at the counter

scenes.say: 직원은 끝까지 웃으며, 아드님 번호로 직접 연락해 드렸어요.
scenes.shot: {teller} calmly talking to {granny} across the counter with a reassuring gesture

scenes.say: 아드님은 회사에서 멀쩡히 일하고 있었어요. 보이스피싱이었던 거죠.
scenes.shot: close up of {granny} frozen in shock with her hand over her mouth
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman slowly covers her mouth in shock, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 돈을 받으러 은행 앞에 와 있던 남자는 경찰에게 붙잡혔어요.
scenes.shot: {officer} escorting a man in a black cap outside a bank entrance
scenes.place: a city street in front of a Korean bank branch, daytime

scenes.say: 아가씨 아니었으면 평생 모은 돈 다 날릴 뻔했네. 고마워요.
scenes.shot: {granny} holding the hands of {teller} with teary grateful eyes
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman gently squeezes the young woman's hands with teary eyes, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 현금으로 찾아오라는 전화, 무조건 끊으세요.
scenes.shot: {granny} and {teller} smiling together at the counter

stories.title: 동창회에서 버스기사 친구 무시한 사장님… 계산대에서 얼어붙었다
stories.place: a Korean restaurant private room with a long low table full of dishes, evening, warm light

brag.look: a flashy Korean man in his late 50s in a shiny suit with a gold watch

quiet.look: a modest Korean man in his late 50s in a plain gray jacket with a gentle smile

owner.look: a Korean restaurant owner woman in her 60s wearing an apron

scenes.say: 삼십 년 만의 고등학교 동창회였어요.
scenes.shot: middle-aged Korean men toasting around the table, {brag} in the center

scenes.say: 나 이번에 차 바꿨잖아. 독일 차야. 너는 아직도 버스 모냐?
scenes.shot: {brag} laughing loudly and pointing at {quiet}

scenes.say: 응, 버스 운전 이십오 년째야. 재밌어.
scenes.shot: {quiet} smiling calmly, holding a glass of water

scenes.say: 오늘은 내가 다 낸다. 다들 나한테 고마워해라.
scenes.shot: {brag} standing up proudly, raising his glass

scenes.say: 그런데 계산대에서 사장님이 고개를 저었어요.
scenes.shot: {brag} at the cashier counter holding a credit card, {owner} shaking her head
scenes.place: the cashier counter of a Korean restaurant, evening

scenes.say: 벌써 계산됐어요. 저분이 매달 동네 어르신들 점심도 대접하시는 분이에요.
scenes.shot: {owner} pointing toward {quiet} sitting at the table
scenes.place: the cashier counter of a Korean restaurant, evening

scenes.say: 큰소리치던 친구는 아무 말도 하지 못했어요.
scenes.shot: close up of {brag} frozen with an awkward embarrassed face, holding a credit card
scenes.place: the cashier counter of a Korean restaurant, evening
scenes.move: static camera, the man's face freezes in embarrassment and he slowly lowers his credit card, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 친구들 얼굴 보는 게 고마워서 그래. 다음에 또 보자.
scenes.shot: {quiet} smiling warmly and patting a friend's shoulder
scenes.move: static camera, the man smiles warmly and nods, very subtle movement, realistic

stories.title: 노숙인 할아버지에게 매일 빵 준 사장님… 한 달 뒤 찾아온 변호사
stories.place: a small cozy neighborhood bakery in Seoul, wooden shelves with bread, morning light

baker.look: a kind Korean woman baker in her late 40s with a white baker's cap and apron

grandpa.look: a thin Korean grandfather in his 80s with white stubble and an old worn coat

customer.look: a picky Korean woman in her 40s in a trench coat

lawyer.look: a Korean male lawyer in his 50s in a dark suit with glasses

scenes.say: 동네 빵집에 매일 아침 오시는 할아버지가 계셨어요.
scenes.shot: {grandpa} standing shyly at the bakery door

scenes.say: 할아버지, 어제 남은 빵이에요. 따뜻할 때 드세요.
scenes.shot: {baker} handing a paper bag of bread to {grandpa}, smiling

scenes.say: 사장님, 저런 분 들이면 손님 떨어져요.
scenes.shot: {customer} frowning at the counter, complaining

scenes.say: 빵은 누구나 먹어야죠.
scenes.shot: {baker} answering calmly with a gentle smile

scenes.say: 그러다 어느 날부터 할아버지가 보이지 않았어요.
scenes.shot: an empty bakery doorway on a rainy morning, a paper bag of bread waiting on the counter

scenes.say: 고인께서 사장님께 편지와 돈을 남기셨어요. 퇴직하신 교장 선생님이셨습니다.
scenes.shot: {lawyer} handing an envelope to {baker} at the counter

scenes.say: 매일 아침 빵 한 봉지가 내 하루를 살게 했소. 이 동네 아이들 빵값에 보태 주시오.
scenes.shot: {baker} reading a handwritten letter with tears
scenes.move: static camera, the woman reads the letter as tears roll down her cheeks, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 그 뒤로 빵집에서는 아이들 빵은 돈을 받지 않는대요.
scenes.shot: {baker} handing bread to smiling schoolchildren at the bakery counter
scenes.move: static camera, the woman gently hands bread to a child and smiles, very subtle movement, realistic

stories.title: 노약자석 청년에게 호통친 할아버지… 청년이 일어나자 모두 숙연해졌다
stories.place: inside a Seoul subway car in the daytime, seats along the sides

old.look: a stern Korean grandfather in his late 70s with a cane and a flat cap

young.look: a quiet Korean man in his early 30s in a plain navy jacket and jeans

lady.look: a Korean woman in her 50s in a beige coat

scenes.say: 지하철 노약자석에 청년 한 명이 앉아 있었어요.
scenes.shot: {young} sitting in a priority seat with his eyes closed, tired

scenes.say: 젊은 사람이 어디 노약자석에 앉아 있어! 당장 안 일어나?
scenes.shot: {old} scolding loudly, pointing his cane at {young}

scenes.say: 청년은 아무 말 없이 일어났어요. 그런데 걸음이 이상했어요.
scenes.shot: {young} standing up slowly holding a pole, wincing in pain

scenes.say: 어르신, 저 청년 다리 좀 보세요.
scenes.shot: {lady} speaking quietly to {old}

scenes.say: 괜찮습니다. 작년에 화재 현장에서 다쳤어요. 소방관이었거든요.
scenes.shot: {young} smiling politely at {old}

scenes.say: 할아버지의 얼굴이 순간 굳었어요.
scenes.shot: close up of {old} frozen in shock and shame
scenes.move: static camera, the old man's face freezes in shock and shame, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 내가 큰 실수를 했네. 우리 같은 사람 지켜 줘서 고맙소.
scenes.shot: {old} taking off his cap and bowing to {young}
scenes.move: static camera, the old man slowly bows his head to the young man, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 겉모습만으로는 아무것도 알 수 없어요.
scenes.shot: {young} and {old} sitting side by side, peaceful

stories.title: 칠순 선물로 낡은 공책 내민 며느리… 시누이가 비웃다 조용해진 이유
stories.place: a Korean family living room at a birthday gathering, a cake with candles on a low table, warm light

mil.look: a Korean grandmother in her early 70s with neat short gray hair and an elegant blouse

dil.look: a gentle Korean woman in her late 30s in a cream cardigan

sil.look: a Korean woman in her early 40s in a stylish black dress

scenes.say: 시어머니 칠순 생신날, 가족들이 선물을 꺼냈어요.
scenes.shot: family gathered around {mil}, gift boxes on the table

scenes.say: 엄마, 명품 가방이야. 언니는 뭐 사 왔어요?
scenes.shot: {sil} proudly holding up a luxury handbag, glancing at {dil}

scenes.say: 며느리가 내민 건 낡은 공책 한 권이었어요.
scenes.shot: {dil} shyly holding out an old notebook tied with a ribbon

scenes.say: 공책이요? 칠순 선물이 이게 다예요?
scenes.shot: {sil} smirking with her arms crossed

scenes.say: 공책에는 어머니가 해 주신 음식 백 가지가 손글씨로 적혀 있었어요.
scenes.shot: close up of an old woman's hands turning the pages of a handwritten recipe notebook

scenes.say: 어머님 손맛, 애들한테도 물려주고 싶어서요. 십 년 동안 옆에서 받아 적었어요.
scenes.shot: {dil} smiling softly

scenes.say: 우리 며느리가, 내 인생을 다 적어 놨구나.
scenes.shot: {mil} with tears, holding the notebook to her chest
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman hugs the notebook to her chest with tears, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 시누이는 조용히 가방을 내려놓았어요.
scenes.shot: {sil} quietly putting down the luxury handbag, looking ashamed
scenes.move: static camera, the woman slowly lowers her eyes and puts down the bag, very subtle movement, realistic

stories.title: 명품 매장서 무시당한 할아버지… 수리 기술자가 달려와 '선생님!'
stories.place: an elegant luxury watch boutique in a Seoul department store, glass display cases, bright lighting

grandpa.look: a modest Korean grandfather in his late 70s in an old brown jacket

clerk.look: a cold young Korean male store clerk in his late 20s in a black suit

master.look: a senior Korean watchmaker in his 60s in a white shirt with a jeweler's loupe on his forehead

scenes.say: 백화점 명품 시계 매장에 허름한 차림의 할아버지가 들어왔어요.
scenes.shot: {grandpa} entering the boutique and looking at the display cases

scenes.say: 이 시계 줄 좀 고칠 수 있을까요? 손녀가 첫 월급으로 사 준 거라.
scenes.shot: {grandpa} holding out an old wristwatch to {clerk}

scenes.say: 어르신, 여긴 그런 데 아니에요. 수리는 본사에 예약하세요.
scenes.shot: {clerk} waving his hand dismissively

scenes.say: 그때 안쪽 수리실에서 나온 기술자가 할아버지를 보고 멈춰 섰어요.
scenes.shot: {master} stopping in surprise as he sees {grandpa}

scenes.say: 선생님! 저 기억하세요? 사십 년 전 종로 시계방에서 저를 가르쳐 주셨잖아요.
scenes.shot: {master} rushing over and holding the hands of {grandpa}

scenes.say: 할아버지는 이 나라 일 세대 시계 장인이었어요.
scenes.shot: close up of {clerk} frozen in shock with his mouth slightly open
scenes.move: static camera, the young clerk freezes in shock with his eyes widening, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 선생님 시계는 제가 직접 고쳐 드리겠습니다.
scenes.shot: {master} carefully holding an old wristwatch with both hands, bowing slightly to {grandpa}
scenes.move: static camera, the watchmaker bows respectfully while holding the watch, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 직원은 그날 처음으로, 손님에게 고개 숙여 사과했어요.
scenes.shot: {clerk} bowing deeply to {grandpa}

stories.title: 가난한 학생에게 늘 덤 주던 할머니… 15년 뒤 병원에서 생긴 일
stories.place: a traditional Korean outdoor market with vegetable stalls, afternoon

granny.look: a cheerful Korean grandmother in her 70s with a floral headscarf and a quilted vest

patient.look: a frail Korean grandmother in her 80s in a hospital patient gown

student.look: a skinny Korean high school boy in a school uniform

doctor.look: a Korean male doctor in his early 30s in a white coat with a stethoscope

scenes.say: 시장 채소 가게 할머니에게는 단골 고등학생이 있었어요.
scenes.shot: {student} buying vegetables at a stall run by {granny}

scenes.say: 엄마 아프다며. 이거 덤이야, 고기도 좀 사 먹어.
scenes.shot: {granny} putting extra vegetables into a bag for {student}

scenes.say: 할머니는 삼 년 동안 그 학생에게 한 번도 제값을 받지 않았어요.
scenes.shot: {granny} waving goodbye warmly to {student}

scenes.say: 그리고 십오 년 뒤, 할머니가 쓰러져 큰 병원에 실려 갔어요.
scenes.shot: {patient} lying in a hospital bed, weak
scenes.place: a clean bright Korean hospital room

scenes.say: 할머니, 저 기억하세요? 덤 주시던 그 학생이에요.
scenes.shot: {doctor} leaning over the hospital bed, smiling with emotion
scenes.place: a clean bright Korean hospital room

scenes.say: 아이고, 네가 의사가 됐구나.
scenes.shot: close up of {patient} in a hospital bed tearing up in surprise
scenes.place: a clean bright Korean hospital room
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman's eyes fill with tears in surprise, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 이번엔 제가 덤 드릴게요. 수술 걱정 마세요.
scenes.shot: {doctor} gently holding the hand of {patient}
scenes.place: a clean bright Korean hospital room
scenes.move: static camera, the doctor gently holds the old woman's hand and smiles, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 할머니의 덤은, 십오 년 만에 돌아왔어요.
scenes.shot: {patient} smiling peacefully by the hospital window
scenes.place: a clean bright Korean hospital room

stories.title: 층간소음에 화나 올라간 청년… 문 너머에서 들린 소리
stories.place: a Korean apartment hallway at night, dim light

youth.look: a Korean man in his early 30s in a gray hoodie

granny.look: a frail Korean grandmother in her 80s with gray hair and a cardigan

scenes.say: 밤 열한 시, 윗집에서 쿵 하는 소리가 났어요.
scenes.shot: {youth} lying on a sofa looking up at the ceiling, annoyed
scenes.place: a small Korean apartment living room at night

scenes.say: 또 시작이네. 이번엔 진짜 올라가서 말해야겠다.
scenes.shot: {youth} getting up from the sofa, frowning
scenes.place: a small Korean apartment living room at night

scenes.say: 그런데 초인종을 눌러도 대답이 없었어요. 안에서 작은 신음 소리만 들렸죠.
scenes.shot: {youth} standing in front of an apartment door, listening carefully, worried

scenes.say: 청년은 바로 119에 신고했어요.
scenes.shot: paramedics in uniforms running up the stairs, {youth} guiding them

scenes.say: 윗집 할머니가 혼자 계시다 쓰러지셨던 거예요.
scenes.shot: paramedics carrying {granny} on a stretcher along the hallway

scenes.say: 며칠 뒤, 퇴원한 할머니가 떡 한 접시를 들고 내려오셨어요.
scenes.sub: 며칠 뒤, 떡을 들고 온 할머니
scenes.shot: {granny} standing at the door holding a plate of rice cakes, smiling
scenes.place: a Korean apartment doorway in the daytime

scenes.say: 총각 덕분에 살았어요. 시끄럽게 해서 미안했어요.
scenes.shot: close up of {granny} smiling gratefully, offering a plate of rice cakes
scenes.place: a Korean apartment doorway in the daytime
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman smiles gratefully and offers the plate, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 아니에요, 할머니. 이제 저녁마다 인사드리러 올게요.
scenes.shot: {youth} smiling warmly and accepting the plate
scenes.place: a Korean apartment doorway in the daytime
scenes.move: static camera, the young man smiles warmly and bows slightly, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 혼자 사시는 이웃, 오늘 한 번 안부를 물어 주세요.
scenes.sub: 혼자 사는 이웃, 안부 한번 물어요
scenes.shot: {youth} and {granny} chatting happily in the apartment hallway
scenes.place: a Korean apartment hallway in the daytime

stories.title: 폐지 줍는 할머니가 창피했던 손자… 졸업식 단상에서 한 말
stories.place: a Korean university graduation ceremony hall, students in gowns, bright daylight

granny.look: a small Korean grandmother in her late 70s with a bent back and a simple padded jacket

student.look: a Korean man in his early 20s in casual clothes

grad.look: a Korean man in his mid 20s in a black graduation gown

scenes.say: 할머니는 손자 등록금을 위해 매일 새벽 폐지를 주우셨어요.
scenes.shot: {granny} pulling a small cart stacked with flattened cardboard
scenes.place: a narrow Korean alley at dawn

scenes.say: 손자는 그런 할머니가 창피해, 친구들 앞에서 모른 척한 적도 있었어요.
scenes.shot: {student} walking past with friends, looking away from {granny}
scenes.place: a Korean university street, daytime

scenes.say: 괜찮다, 우리 강아지. 공부만 열심히 해라.
scenes.shot: {granny} smiling and handing an envelope to {student}
scenes.place: a small old Korean room with a warm lamp

scenes.say: 사 년 뒤 졸업식, 손자는 수석 졸업생 대표로 단상에 섰어요.
scenes.shot: {grad} standing at a podium on stage

scenes.say: 제 등록금은 할머니가 새벽마다 주운 폐지로 냈습니다.
scenes.shot: {grad} speaking at the podium with emotion

scenes.say: 할머니, 그동안 모른 척해서 죄송했어요. 사랑합니다.
scenes.shot: {grad} kneeling and bowing deeply in front of {granny}
scenes.move: static camera, the young man bows deeply in front of the old woman, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 할머니는 손자의 학사모를 쓰고 한참을 우셨어요.
scenes.shot: {granny} wearing a graduation cap, crying and smiling
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman cries and smiles under the graduation cap, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 그날 졸업식장에서 가장 큰 박수를 받은 사람은 할머니였어요.
scenes.shot: graduates applauding {granny} who is standing next to {grad}

stories.title: 출근길 갑자기 멈춘 버스… 화내던 승객이 고개 숙인 이유
stories.place: inside a Korean city bus in the morning, passengers seated

driver.look: a Korean male bus driver in his 50s in a light blue uniform shirt

passenger.look: an impatient Korean man in his 40s in a business suit

granny.look: an elderly Korean woman in her 70s in a purple coat

scenes.say: 출근 시간, 버스가 갑자기 길가에 멈춰 섰어요.
scenes.shot: {driver} stopping the bus and turning his head back urgently

scenes.say: 아니 기사님, 지금 뭐 하시는 거예요? 다들 바빠요!
scenes.shot: {passenger} standing up angrily

scenes.say: 기사님은 대답 대신 뒷자리로 달려갔어요. 할머니 한 분이 쓰러져 계셨거든요.
scenes.shot: {driver} rushing to the back of the bus where {granny} has collapsed on a seat

scenes.say: 119 좀 불러 주세요! 제가 심폐소생술 하겠습니다.
scenes.shot: {driver} kneeling and giving chest compressions to {granny} lying on the bus floor, passengers watching

scenes.say: 구급차가 올 때까지 칠 분, 기사님은 한 번도 멈추지 않았어요.
scenes.shot: close up of {driver} sweating and concentrating

scenes.say: 할머니가 숨을 몰아쉬며 눈을 떴어요.
scenes.shot: close up of {granny} slowly opening her eyes
scenes.move: static camera, the old woman slowly opens her eyes and breathes, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 소리치던 남자는 조용히 다가와 기사님께 고개를 숙였어요.
scenes.shot: {passenger} bowing his head to {driver}
scenes.move: static camera, the man slowly bows his head in apology, very subtle movement, realistic

scenes.say: 그날 버스 안 승객들은 모두 기사님께 박수를 보냈어요.
scenes.shot: passengers applauding {driver} inside the bus, warm atmosphere
